description: High-confidence detections escalate to warn. Medium-confidence detections warn. Low-confidence detections log only. Class D tools require approval. No blocks. Use after baseline FP rate is established from visibility-only phase.

policy_overrides.description: Low confidence band: log only, no notification
Medium confidence band: log and notify analyst
High confidence band: warn (not block) — allows analyst review before any enforcement escalation
Class D tools always require approval regardless of confidence band
Drift detection rules remain at detect-only; posture is audit, not active
Drift detection rules remain at detect-only
Drift detection rules remain at detect-only

tradeoffs.fp_exposure: moderate — warn decisions generate analyst notifications; FP warnings create noise but no enforcement impact under audit posture
tradeoffs.coverage: full visibility with analyst notification on medium and high signals
tradeoffs.recommended_duration: days 14–30 of pilot, after reviewing FP rate from visibility-only phase
